lines.en: We have been here for centuries,
in this beautiful Aegean Sea.
Here are our holy roots
from the same mothers born here.

lines.cyr: Велат нè нема ама еве сме
lines.lat: Velat nè nema ama eve sme
lines.en: They say we are gone, but here we are,

lines.cyr: со мерак сред Солун оро играме.
lines.lat: so merak sred Solun oro igrame.
lines.en: willingly dancing оро in the middle of Solun.

lines.cyr: Велат нè нема, ама еве сме
lines.lat: Velat nè nema, ama eve sme
lines.en: They say we are gone, but here we are,
proudly singing Macedonian songs.
Here in Solun, Drama, Kavala
in Kukush, Voden, pretty Grevena,
up there on Vicho, heroic Gramos,
they dance and sing again in the Macedonian language.

lines.cyr: Велат нè нема ама еве сме
lines.lat: Velat nè nema ama eve sme
lines.en: They say we are gone, but here we are,

lines.cyr: со мерак сред Солун оро играме.
lines.lat: so merak sred Solun oro igrame.
lines.en: willingly dancing оро in the middle of Thessaloniki.

lines.cyr: Велат нè нема, ама еве сме
lines.lat: Velat nè nema, ama eve sme
lines.en: They say we are gone, but here we are,
proudly singing Macedonian songs.

lines.cyr: Тука сме ние од пред Исуса
lines.lat: Tuka sme nie od pred Isusa
lines.en: We have been here since before Jesus Christ,
on our Macedonian land.
We are here, we remain here,
and we do not change our holy name.
